objective: Determine which Nikkei 225 futures venue is leading price discovery at each institutional session state, then use that state only to weight contemporaneous information sources for JNU.

evidence.reference: Lee et al. (2015), Price linkage between the US and Japanese futures across different time zones
evidence.implication: Nikkei futures leadership changes with venue/time and can change across eras.
Same-underlying offshore/onshore venue leadership must be measured with venue-specific data rather than public symbols.

evidence.reference: 2023 nonlinear Nikkei spot-futures price discovery study
evidence.implication: Liquidity/transaction-cost conditions can make leadership nonlinear/state-dependent.

primary_target.reason: Longer history and same underlying as JNU; true JNU Micro is used later for exact-product consistency.

contract_alignment.rule: Compare the same quarterly expiry across OSE, SGX and CME whenever simultaneously listed.
contract_alignment.roll_rule: Predefine roll by exchange last-trading-day/volume availability before inspecting predictive results.
contract_alignment.serial_months: Excluded from G1 unless all three venues have an economically equivalent matched expiry.

official_session_calendar.timezone_policy: Store raw timestamps in UTC plus venue-local timezone; derive state labels from versioned official exchange calendars. Never hard-code one UTC clock across DST.

CME.general_nikkei_globex: Sunday-Friday approximately 18:00-17:00 ET under current fact-card convention
CME.rule: Use official CME holiday/maintenance calendar per observation date; DST conversion is mandatory.

SGX_PRE_OSE_DAY.definition: SGX Nikkei trading while OSE day session has not opened.
SGX_PRE_OSE_DAY.hypothesis: SGX may carry same-underlying information into the OSE day open.

OSE_DAY_OVERLAP.definition: OSE day and SGX T both active.
OSE_DAY_OVERLAP.hypothesis: Local OSE leadership should strengthen while Japan's home venue is in primary trading hours.

SGX_BRIDGE_TO_OSE_NIGHT.definition: SGX T/T+1 active while OSE is between day close and 17:00 night open.
SGX_BRIDGE_TO_OSE_NIGHT.hypothesis: SGX may temporarily become the only continuously active Asian Nikkei venue.

OSE_NIGHT_OVERLAP.definition: OSE night plus SGX T+1 and CME Nikkei overlap when calendars permit.
OSE_NIGHT_OVERLAP.hypothesis: Leadership may depend on contemporaneous venue liquidity rather than fixed home-market dominance.

US_CASH_OVERLAP.definition: US regular cash session while Nikkei futures venues are open.
US_CASH_OVERLAP.hypothesis: CME/same-underlying and US equity-index information may gain influence; NQ/ES are exogenous confirmation, not part of same-underlying venue leadership score.

SINGLE_VENUE_OR_HOLIDAY.definition: One venue open while another is holiday/maintenance closed.
SINGLE_VENUE_OR_HOLIDAY.hypothesis: Use as natural leadership episodes, but do not pool across distinct holiday types without preregistered grouping.

sampling.reason: Pilot 1m had only 2 OOS days and is too fragile; 5m reduces microstructure noise and aligns better across venue timestamps.
sampling.secondary_interval: 1m diagnostic only if sufficient multi-month true-venue history exists
sampling.same_bar_rule: Lag 0 describes contemporaneous linkage, never tradable lead.

causal_features.returns: Log/percentage return per venue from causal bar closes.
liquidity: realized spread proxy only if true bid/ask available
allowed_exogenous: NQ/ES returns only in separately labeled US-overlap diagnostics
prohibited: Using future bar volume to decide the current bar's source weight

primary_tests.predictors: Lagged same-expiry SGX/CME Nikkei returns up to frozen ±3-bar diagnostic structure; prediction uses only strictly prior bars.
primary_tests.interpretation: Only strictly positive lags are eligible as predictive information.

primary_tests.target: OSE next-bar return or next-bar variance
primary_tests.interpretation: A pass supports source weighting, not standalone directional alpha.

validation.purging_embargo: Required whenever prediction horizons overlap training/test boundaries.
validation.family_correction: Holm or SPA/Reality-Check-style correction across the frozen venue/state comparisons.
validation.bootstrap: Block bootstrap with block length preregistered after inspecting autocorrelation structure on training data only.
validation.true_target_confirmation: After Mini long-history G1, repeat frozen state logic on OSE Micro 2023+ without retuning.

required: Venue-specific OSE + SGX + CME intraday data with matched expiries
At least one predefined state shows positive incremental OOS value after family correction
No result depends solely on one year or one venue outage regime
Leadership sign/state logic remains directionally consistent in recent data
Exact-product Micro check does not materially contradict Mini result
promotion_gate.not_allowed: Directional trading promotion from DPD alone

current_data_blockers: OSE official JPX one-minute history is paid; no purchase authorized.
225Labo is the preferred already-available personal OSE source but raw files must remain local.
Free/authorized SGX venue-specific historical intraday series has not yet been verified.
Free/authorized CME NIY historical intraday series has not yet been verified.

cloud_policy.raw_exchange_data: Only store in cloud when license/terms explicitly allow it.
cloud_policy.personally_licensed_225labo: Raw local-only; cloud may store non-reconstructable derived features, hashes and provenance.

forbidden: Optimize session boundaries after seeing results
Mix different expiries to increase sample size
Treat same-bar correlation as price leadership
Assign fixed NQ/SGX/OSE weights before OOS confirmation
Purchase data without explicit user authorization
